title: Updated my space game
author: Competitive_Might709
selftext:
Did some visual updates to my game 

Tell me guys what you think 

Built this game with Astra 6 in three days.  
   
If you want to play it tell me in the comments and I drop a link 👌

comments.author: -Star-Walker-
comments.body:
Honest opinion:  
\- Your ship moves way too fast (mouse? … don’t use a mouse as input device or restrict its moment speed)  
\- The enemies move too slow  
\- The enemy‘s bullets move too slow  
\- No real enemy wave patterns   
\- Your background assumes, that your ship is flying backwards??? (Scrolling the wrong direction)  
\- Your weapons overpower too fast  
\- Looks way too easy

Have a look at RAIDEN II (one of the best vertical scrollers ever). If possible, play it! Yes, it’s very difficult, but those games are supposed to be that way.

replies.author: Competitive_Might709
replies.body:
Love your opinion,this kind of opinions that I need.   
Thank you I will update my game.

replies.author: -Star-Walker-
replies.body:
I hoped so. It’s useless to say what’s „good“ because „good“ doesn’t need to be fixed.   
Keep on building your game … and keep this attitude 👍

replies.author: Competitive_Might709
replies.body:
Already implemented what you told me but I have some bugs , I will fix it 👌  
Thank you

comments.author: Every-Prize4720
comments.body:
nice work. wonder how this kind of game could have balanced boss fights where they are not damage sponges nor frameperfect bullshit mechanics.

keep it up!

replies.author: Competitive_Might709
replies.body: On the contrary, I want to bring back a bit of that old feeling—at least the way I feel it.
